finding: The early rejected cue 7 consumes the shared short retry at window end 44.714 s. Cue 8 later supplies a fresh credible anchor, but unsupported cue 10 cannot request another short retry. Recovery regresses to 28.5 s; full scene acceptance fails.
proposedFollowup: Rearm a spent short retry only when an accepted cue-start anchor is later than the end of the window that requested the previous retry. Repeated or overlapping old anchors cannot rearm it. Keep matching, VAD, fitter and scoring thresholds unchanged.
